_comment: Baseline CPU instruction counts for AuraVault contract functions. Generated by running `cargo test gas_ -- --nocapture 2>&1 | grep GAS_MEASUREMENT`. Update by running scripts/update-gas-baselines.sh. CI fails if any function exceeds its baseline by more than 10%. A value of 0 means the measurement is skipped (e.g. upgrade requires a live Wasm blob).

deposit.note: first deposit, 1:1 share mint, token transfer

harvest.note: yield injection, fee calculation, token transfer

balance_of.note: read-only storage read with address key

upgrade.note: skipped — requires live Wasm blob at runtime
